orientation.title: Mexico beach destinations
orientation.heading: Explore the best of Mexico
orientation.summary: From Cancún’s energy to Puerto Vallarta’s laid-back charm, Mexico’s beach towns deliver for teens and stay under budget. Which one is calling you?
orientation.moreText: Here are a few more places within your budget to consider
orientation.alternateHeading: Not Mexico, but still beachy fun.
orientation.alternateText: Sun and surf with a different vibe. These resorts are closer to Houston and may cost less.

destinationBlurbs.cancun: Cancun has the most teen-friendly activities in your budget, but has a loud and busy nightlife scene that may not be ideal for your teens.
destinationBlurbs.puertoVallarta: Puerto Vallarta pairs a laid-back beach atmosphere with family-friendly dining and a calmer pace for evenings together.
destinationBlurbs.playaDelCarmen: Playa del Carmen offers walkable beaches, activities, and shopping with easy access to the Riviera Maya.
